verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own export of balance statements in open and standard formats (JSON, CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), which covers transaction history, a core part of a user's data. There is no evidence of a complete account-wide export or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export covering recipients, cards, documents and profile data; any documented account-closure or offboarding flow; independent or hands-on confirmation that exports are complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
Retrieve information on transactions made on your users' cards.
